spec.purpose: Research a given topic thoroughly, draft a well-structured article based on the research, and critique the draft to produce a polished final piece.

desired_roles.name: researcher
desired_roles.goal: Produce a comprehensive, accurate research brief on the assigned topic.

desired_roles.name: writer
desired_roles.goal: Transform research findings into a compelling, readable article draft.

desired_roles.name: fact_checker
desired_roles.description: Verifies all factual claims in the article draft against credible sources before editorial review.
desired_roles.goal: Ensure every factual statement in the article is accurate, properly sourced, and free from misinformation.

desired_roles.name: critic
desired_roles.goal: Ensure the article meets high editorial standards and is ready for publication.

desired_tasks.name: research_topic
desired_tasks.description: Research the assigned topic comprehensively, gathering key facts, data, expert opinions, and credible sources. Produce a structured research brief.

desired_tasks.name: draft_article
desired_tasks.description: Using the research brief, draft a well-structured, engaging article with a clear introduction, body sections, and conclusion.

desired_tasks.name: fact_check_draft
desired_tasks.description: Review every factual claim in the article draft, cross-reference against credible sources, flag any inaccuracies or unsupported statements, and produce an annotated fact-check report alongside a corrected draft.

desired_tasks.name: critique_and_revise
desired_tasks.description: Critically review the fact-checked article draft for accuracy, clarity, tone, structure, and style. Provide detailed feedback and deliver a polished final version.
